title: Health: halve the waiting lists, or stop them rising?
note: A commitment restated as a weaker one (moving the goalposts), a question dodged twice, an ad hominem against a panelist's motives, a return to the subject, and a cue.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Let's turn to the health service. Minister, are you on track to halve waiting lists?

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: Our commitment is clear. We will halve waiting lists by 2027.

turns.speaker: DOC
turns.text: Waiting lists have gone up by 200,000 since then.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: So are you on track, minister, yes or no?

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: What matters is that waiting lists are no longer rising as fast as they were.

turns.speaker: DOC
turns.text: With respect, that is moving the goalposts.

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: The doctor would say that. His union has been on strike for months.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Let's stay with patients. Doctor, what would help most?

turns.speaker: DOC
turns.text: More nurses. We have 40,000 vacancies right now.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Hepta, before we go on, anything to flag?
